title: Brazil's Novo Desenrola Debt Relief Program Ends This Monday
seoTitle: Brazil's Novo Desenrola Program Ends Monday
subtitle: The debt renegotiation program comes to an end following an extension in early August
excerpt: Novo Desenrola Brasil, the federal debt renegotiation program, ends this Monday after being extended in early August.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The debt renegotiation program known as Novo Desenrola Brasil comes to an end this Monday.

As previously reported, the initiative was extended in early August, giving beneficiaries additional time to settle their outstanding debts.

With the scheduled conclusion, the program will no longer accept new renegotiation requests as of this date.

With information from Agência Brasil.
